d: In this episode of Rajdoot, Hosted by Nikhil, Written by Sajid, we look at how Israeli Arab parties have emerged as potential kingmakers after Israel’s closely contested election, putting Benjamin Netanyahu’s political future in doubt. You will learn how the Arab parties representing Palestinian citizens of Israel are projected to win around 18 seats, why neither Netanyahu’s right-wing religious alliance nor the opposition bloc led by Gadi Eisenkot appears to have secured the 61 seats needed for a parliamentary majority, and whether Arab lawmakers could help bring Netanyahu’s long rule to…
